usage: Fed by tools/direct.py to generate three structurally distinct concept directions; agents refine, never ship these raw. Options are seeds of contrast, not templates.

options.behavior: Open on the exact question; every later layer answers one clause.
Follow one object through states; camera age/time cues only when they earn it.
Numbers tighten; rhythm accelerates; hold before the final value.
Two visual registers share frame; the cut point is the argument.
Viewer POV moves through a schematic space that reacts on cue.
Documents/claims pin onto a surface; connections drawn between them.
The subject's physical substance (fiber, glass, ore) carries meaning through its states.
Construction-line drawing space; built forms emerge from measurements.
Clinical framing: items under plates, labels, focus pulls like examination.
Values as stars/orbits; distances encode magnitudes honestly.
One continuous morph from before-state to after-state across the whole film.
Statistics behave like climate: fronts, pressure, tides animate the argument.
2-color misregistration, paper bite, hard ink edges.
Soft 2.5D planes, volumetric light, physical contact shadows.
Hatching density carries tone; lines draw on as argument progresses.
Translucent stacked panels; depth via refraction cues, blur budget respected.
Flat solid shapes, sharp negativespace, stop-motion stepped life.
Grid, mono labels, exact easing; motion reads as instrumentation.
One huge Arabic word builds by shaped-matte bands; everything else is whisper.
Lines arrive as a column; each line own easing; underline traces separately.
Small labels scatter onto targets; leader lines trim in from anchors.
Primary statement static; secondary thoughts intrude from margin with delay.
Digits are the protagonists; glyph-level counter motion only for Latin/numerals.
Two type voices alternate; alternation itself carries the narrative beat.
No camera; all motion is performed by layers. Default when content is busy.
Slow drift reframes the focal element; secondary depth ratio 0.4–0.6.
Dolly into one component as its name is spoken; settle, no bounce.
Content moves through a fixed window; focus rules are separate layers.
Transitions are camera moves that physically connect two scenes once only.
Focus shifts between planes carry the reading order; blur budget documented.
All entrances keyed to narration words; music secondary and ducked.
On-beat accents every 2 s min; holds on meaning, not on grid.
Late entrances and abrupt stops create tension at argument turns.
Long stillness, dense action, stillness; only for heavy claims.
Interval shrinks toward the reveal; final beat is a hard hold.
One hue marks truth; its reappearances are the through-line.
Accents are trim-path strokes timed half a beat after the word.
Emphasis via light windows over muted base.
Highlights bloom like ink on paper; never opacity-fade boxes.
Counters, brackets, ticks; instrumentation aesthetic.
Cuts are the rhythm; no transition when content changes scale anyway.
A scene element wipes the frame; incoming element pre-positioned behind it.
Same geometry changes role (circle→lens→chart); vertices correspond.
Exit through a portal the next scene opens into.
The connecting word persists across both scenes and mutates state.

anti_patterns: Choosing options because they were the previous project's identity.
Rendering all directions with the same composition skeleton.
Shipping a direction whose rationale field is still TODO.
Reading 'style' as a filter preset rather than a system of decisions.
